halves.name: Ride-or-Die
halves.desc: You're in it with your people all the way, and you'll tell them the truth on the way in. Your loyalty is loud, honest and done your way.

axes.line: Your people are your happy place. Close means shared: plans, snacks, calendars.
You say the hard thing to their face, because that's how you show respect.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: The Routine Lover
halves.desc: Your days run on a routine you picked and like. You know what works for you, and you're in no rush to prove anything to anyone. Same café, same walk, same good choice.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.

stings: You'd go to war for your people. Letting them fight for you is the part you skip.
Your days are so settled that some nights you wonder about the other version.
hearts: I'm all in, and I tell the truth. You get both.
I chose my ordinary days. I didn't settle for them.

tags.name: Fair to everyone
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process because you don't quite trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Read it, won the point, then lost on that exact rule.
"Booked it two weeks ago. The stairwell has great acoustics."
Zero. The syllabus doesn't read reviews.

tags.name: First to help family
tags.heart: When my people need someone, I want it to be me.
tags.sting: You're everyone's plan B, and your own plan A keeps moving to next month.

youToldGenii.said: Said "what time?" before asking what it was. A fourth-floor couch.
Accept. Lanyard ordered. Send me your problems.
Clear them a drawer. Stay as long as it takes.

tags.name: Starts new traditions
tags.heart: No script is the gift I gave myself.
tags.sting: No script means every choice at home is yours to make, and to explain.

youToldGenii.said: Didn't miss it once. Best night that month.
Ran the chores on a system my family would find deeply weird
Invented a weekly home ritual with a name. Soup Sunday counts

tags.name: Protects free time
tags.heart: My own growth is a contribution too.
tags.sting: You cheer for good causes from the sidelines. Your weekends are booked with you.

youToldGenii.said: Not me. I studied my shoes until someone cracked.
Pass. My Saturdays already belong to a half-built canoe.
"Off duty. I'm in sweatpants and staying there."

tags.name: Knows when to recharge
tags.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.
tags.sting: When your battery hits zero you're gone, and not everyone gets that it isn't about them.

youToldGenii.said: Said no. My rule doesn't come with a friends list.
Muted their chat for a night so I could sleep
Sent a meme instead of asking "how are you, really?"

calls.line: You've read the terms and conditions on something.
You're the one the family calls when the wifi breaks.
Your future home will have at least one tradition you invented.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Unscrewing the doorframe. The height marks continue at my place.’ Last time, you did: ‘Didn't miss it once. Best night that month.’
